title: 第9章 御姐控和姐控是有区别的
slug: 无限气运主宰全本免费-无限气运主宰最新章节列表
content_zh:
注意到那从天而降的身影，他瞬间大喜，道：“江琴，你终于把大哥给请来了？”
苏景一边疯狂的驾车，皮鞭不要命的在马屁~股上抽打，一边说道：“没错，大爷已经到了，眼下正在与十二星相动手，恐怕要不多时便要分出胜负，公子您安全了！！！”
“那我们为什么还要逃？”
世上还有人比江枫更知道燕南天的实力的吗？
有他在的话，恐怕哪怕是移花宫邀月亲至，也不必畏惧的吧？
甚至于若不是月奴如今身怀六甲，江枫不敢冒险的话，恐怕他在燕南天到来的这一刻，就已经直接停下脚步不再逃跑了……兄弟二人痛快一战便是。
可惜……孩子，可以让父母变的强大的同时，也让本来坚不可摧的心灵，多了一道几乎轻易便可摧毁的弱点！
江枫几乎是一点风险都不敢去冒了。
但只是对付区区十二星相……为何要逃？
“不逃不行啊！”
苏景拼命的驾着马车，往远处奔逃而去，口中高声道：“公子您可别忘了，大爷知道的是您被移花宫中的妖女追杀，他是来救您的，但他也是来杀妖女的，而现在，你车里还躺着一个妖女呢！”
江枫本能的辩驳道：“月奴是不一样的！”
他道：“你就没有跟大哥详细解释一下吗？月奴是更温柔和体贴的……”
“我解释了，但大爷不信，他说妖女没一个好东西，尤其他们宫主邀月，更是阴险卑鄙，奸诈无耻，下**~荡”
喀~~~！！！
邀月清楚的听到了自己手指被掐的脆响的声音。
“几天前没把这小子折磨的更狠一点，果然是个失误啊！”
她阴冷的笑了起来，若非刚刚听到的话里面，有自己感兴趣的东西，恐怕她现在已经冲出去，把那可恨的书童给碎尸万段了！
不过现在，哼……看来要把这小子给擒回移花宫，还有最后两天，定然要好好的看一看他临死前痛苦挣扎的神情，以泄自己心头之恨！
而苏景这边，难得有机会狠狠的一报之前被折磨之仇，他越骂越是过瘾，足足骂了好久好久，这才道：“反正大爷对移花宫中女子颇多偏见，一听公子竟然已经跟移花宫中的女子走到了一起，立即就认定了那女子定然是欺骗了公子，眼下，他要来杀邀月怜星那两个贱人的心思不重，反倒是夫人，他咬牙切齿，似乎是要除之而后快呢！”

“既如此，那不必再逃了！”
从马车里慢慢的探出了一只纤细的手臂，花月奴艰难的露出了头来，她的相貌并不如邀月那般白皙如玉，也不如何美丽，五官俱都普通，但那股温婉的气质，却让人瞬间便忍不住沉醉于她那温和的双眸之内……就像一个大姐姐一样！
苏景瞬间了然，感情江枫不是御姐控，而是姐控！
难怪他看不上邀月了。
她把手搭在江枫的臂膀上，轻声道：“枫郎，既然如此的话，我们不要逃了……等大哥到了，我们慢慢跟他解释就是了！大宫主手段滔天，能保我们安危的，恐怕只有大哥了。”
花月奴话音才刚刚落下。
突然，一道粗豪的声音喝道：“可笑，谁要保你这贱人！！！”
一袒胸露乳的大汉大踏步的奔了过来，两条长腿奔跑间，速度竟然比马车还要更快几分……
片刻之间，便已经生生追上了那正在疾驰的马车后面，伸手便拽住了马车的支柱，喝道：“给我下来吧妖女！！！”
用力一撕！
哗啦啦啦的巨响声中，伴随着女子惊慌的叫声。
马车的篷架，直接被生生从后到前，拆了个粉碎！
马车立时变成了架车，而车上那相貌温婉的女子，也终于显露出了全貌……
窈窕的身姿，小腹却已经高高的隆起，显然，这女子已经身怀六甲。
“月奴！！！”
江枫失声惊叫了起来。
“呀……”
苏景也惊叫了起来，那大汉力大无穷，突然用力的一拉，不仅生生撕了马车，更连奔驰的骏马都生生打了个趔趄，受惊的马匹立时慌不择路的奔了起来。
“小心！”
苏景高呼一声，用力想要止住马车……但马车却哪里止的住，眼见它朝着身侧远处的悬崖峭壁奔去。

苏景用力拉却怎么也拉不住，眼见马车便要带着三个人奔下悬崖……

content_en:
Noticing the figure falling from the sky, he was instantly overjoyed and said, "Jiang Qin, have you finally invited your eldest brother?"
Su Jing drove crazily and slapped the horse's buttocks with the whip as he said: "Yes, the uncle has arrived. He is currently fighting against the twelve stars. I am afraid that the winner will be determined soon. Master, you are safe!!!"
"Then why are we running away?"
Is there anyone in the world who knows Yan Nantian's strength better than Jiang Feng?
If he is here, I am afraid that even if Yihua Palace invites Yue to visit, there is no need to be afraid, right?
Even if Yue Nu was pregnant with Liujia and Jiang Feng did not dare to take risks, I am afraid that he would have stopped running away the moment Yan Nantian arrived... The two brothers would have fought happily.
It's a pity... Children can make parents strong, but they also add a weakness to the originally indestructible mind that can be destroyed almost easily!
Jiang Feng almost didn't dare to take any risks.
But it's just to deal with the twelve zodiac signs... Why run away?
“I can’t do it without escaping!”
Su Jing drove the carriage as hard as he could and ran away in the distance, saying loudly: "Master, please don't forget that what I know is that you are being chased by the witch in Yihua Palace. He is here to save you, but he is also here to kill the witch. And now, there is a witch lying in your car!"
Jiang Feng instinctively argued: "Yue Slave is different!"
He said: "Didn't you explain it in detail to the elder brother? Yue Nu is more gentle and considerate..."
"I explained it, but the uncle didn't believe it. He said that none of the witches are good, especially their Palace Master Yaoyue, who is insidious, despicable, treacherous and shameless, and slutty."
Kah~~~! ! !
Yao Yue clearly heard the crisp sound of her fingers being pinched.
"It was indeed a mistake for not torturing this boy more harshly a few days ago!"
She laughed coldly. If there wasn't something she was interested in in what she just heard, she would have rushed out by now and cut the hateful book boy into pieces!
But now, huh... It seems that we have to capture this kid back to Yihua Palace. There are still two days left, so we must take a good look at his expression of painful struggle before death to vent the hatred in his heart!
As for Su Jing, it was a rare opportunity to retaliate for the torture he had suffered before. The more he scolded, the more he enjoyed it. After scolding him for a long time, he said: "Anyway, the uncle is quite prejudiced against the women in Yihua Palace. When I heard that the young master has already gone to Yihua Palace, The woman in the middle came together and immediately determined that the woman must have deceived the young master. Now, he is not serious about coming to kill the two bitches Yaoyue Lianxing, but the madam. He gritted his teeth and seemed to want to get rid of them quickly! "
"In that case, there's no need to run away anymore!"
A slender arm slowly stretched out from the carriage, and Hua Yuenu revealed her head with difficulty. Her appearance was not as fair as Yaoyue, nor was she very beautiful. Her facial features were all ordinary, but her gentle temperament made people instantly unable to help but indulge in her gentle eyes... Just like a big sister!
Su Jing instantly understood that Jiang Feng's feelings were not controlled by his sister, but by his sister!
No wonder he looks down on Yao Yue.
She put her hand on Jiang Feng's arm and said softly: "Fenglang, if that's the case, let's not run away... When the eldest brother arrives, we'll just explain it to him slowly! The eldest palace master's methods are monstrous, and I'm afraid the only one who can keep us safe is the eldest brother."
Hua Yuenu's words had just finished.
Suddenly, a rough voice shouted: "That's ridiculous, who's going to protect you bitch!!!"
A big man with bare chest and breasts ran over with long strides. As he ran with his long legs, he was even faster than a carriage...
In a moment, he had already caught up with the speeding carriage. He reached out and grabbed the pillar of the carriage and shouted: "Come down here, you witch! ! ! "
Tear it hard!
The loud crashing sound was accompanied by the woman's panicked cry.
The awning of the carriage was torn to pieces from back to front!
The carriage immediately turned into a carriage, and the gentle-looking woman in the carriage finally revealed her full face...
She has a slim figure, but her belly is already bulging. It is obvious that this woman is pregnant.
“Moon slave! ! ! "
Jiang Feng screamed in surprise.
"Yeah..."
Su Jing also screamed. The big man was so powerful that he suddenly pulled hard and not only tore the carriage apart, but also staggered the galloping horses. The frightened horses immediately started running in panic.
"Be careful! "
Su Jing shouted loudly and tried hard to stop the carriage...but the carriage couldn't stop. He saw it running towards the cliff far away from him.
Su Jing pulled hard but couldn't hold it back. When he saw the carriage, he was about to lead the three people off the cliff...
